scripts.dev: LEXVERSE_WEB_MODE=serve bun run scripts/export-static-data.ts && bun run scripts/prepare-mode.ts && LEXVERSE_WEB_MODE=serve next dev --port 3456
scripts.build: LEXVERSE_WEB_MODE=serve bun run scripts/export-static-data.ts && bun run scripts/prepare-mode.ts && LEXVERSE_WEB_MODE=serve next build
scripts.build:static: STATIC_EXPORT=1 LEXVERSE_WEB_MODE=static bun run scripts/export-static-data.ts && bun run scripts/prepare-mode.ts --static && (STATIC_EXPORT=1 LEXVERSE_WEB_MODE=static next build; code=$?; bun run scripts/prepare-mode.ts; exit $code)
